name: reveal
description: Make a hidden entity here known to the player.

target_id.description: Exact id of something hidden here.
Exact id of who here died.

name: join_party
description: Make a person here travel with the player.

target_id.description: Exact id of who is joining.

name: leave_party
description: Make a party member stop travelling with the player.

target_id.description: Exact id of the party member leaving.

name: move_item
description: Move an item to a new holder.

item_id.description: Exact id of an item here or carried.

to_id.description: Exact id of the player, an npc here, or this place.

name: unlock_way
description: Open a locked way out of this place.

to_id.description: Exact id of the locked way's destination.

name: move
description: Move the player through an unlocked way out of this place.

to_id.description: Exact id of the place to move to.

with_ids.description: Exact ids of living npcs here who follow one time. Party members come without this field.

name: meanwhile
description: Time passes where the player is not. Move a dweller, move a loose item, and shut a way the player knows. Use any combination in one call. Call this only while ELSEWHERE is shown.

dweller_id.description: Exact id of a dweller elsewhere who walks to a new place.

dweller_to_id.description: Exact id of the place the dweller walks to.

item_id.description: Exact id of a loose item elsewhere that moves to a new place.

item_to_id.description: Exact id of the place the item moves to.

shut_from_id.description: Exact id of one end of the way that shuts.

shut_to_id.description: Exact id of the other end of the way that shuts.

name: hire
description: Call this when the player hires a character here to work. The player can also hire a character who already travels with the player. The worldsmith writes the sheet of that character at the end of the turn. Nothing more happens this turn. Give a sheet only to a character hired to work. Do not give a sheet to a character who only travels along.

target_id.description: Exact id of who here signs on.

terms.description: What they are hired for, and on what terms, as agreed.

name: rest
description: The player and the party rest here for one night. Their Health goes to full.

name: roll
description: Call this for an uncertain action that has a real cost. The engine rolls 2d6, adds the ability and the items, and reads the total.

what.description: The attempt, in a few words the player reads.

ability.description: The ability that the action uses.

item_ids.description: Exact ids of items the actor carries and that clearly help.

difficulty.description: Difficulty Score: 8 easy, 10 moderate, 12 hard. Null when `target_id` is set.

target_id.description: Exact id of an npc here that the actor acts on, in a fight or in talk. The Health of that npc is the Difficulty Score.

dangerous.description: True when a miss would hurt. Talk is not dangerous unless the story says so.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

name: level_up
description: Call this one time, when the whole adventure ends. The engine gives the choice to the player first, then to each living hired member in turn.

ability.description: The ability to raise by 1. Null asks the player.

boost.description: Health or Inventory: which one to raise by 1. Null asks the player.
